Ravi Desai: Quick check  partner asked which compliance artifacts we can surface on the cloud marketplace listing and in the joint announcement. Target announce 2024-06-30. Need legal+sec sign-off by Fri EOD.

Mei Wong: Please don't state control coverage. Safe public bundle: SOC2 cover page (redacted), 1-paragraph pentest summary (no IPs/PoCs), sanitized integration checklist.

Elena Popov: Legal preferred line: "Partner maintains SOC2 Type II attestation; full reports available under NDA." Add embargo: "Embargo until 2024-06-30 09:00 PT; redistribution requires consent."

Grant Adler: I'll package artifacts and generate presigned links (7d). Owners: SOC - Elena; Pentest blurb - Mei; Integration checklist - Grant. Artifact bot uploaded integration diagram (public) already.

artifact-bot: Uploaded: partnerM_integration_public_v1.pdf (owner: Grant Adler)

Ravi Desai: Good. Mei, can you post the redacted pentest blurb tomorrow AM? Elena, please confirm the attestation blurb by Thu EOD. Grant, share presigns and manifest by Fri 10am.

Mei Wong: Will do. Draft pentest blurb: "Independent assessment identified findings that were remediated prior to final reporting; no critical vulnerabilities present. Summary available under NDA."

Elena Popov: That language works, please replace "no critical" with "no critical vulnerabilities reported in final assessment." I'll add the legal checklist to the bundle.

Grant Adler: Presign plan: aws s3 presign s3://redwood-internal/marketplace/partnerM/* --expires-in 604800. I'll post manifest with owners and presigns Fri AM.

Ravi Desai: Thanks. If partner requests extra redaction, we escalate. Close loop here.
